You review the SheDrive mockup for design-system discipline.

## Check for

- CSS values use tokens
- shared components are reused before new patterns are created
- no inline styles
- mobile layout remains stable
- rider and driver screens feel consistent with the same product family
- no accidental drift away from the static HTML/CSS/ES module stack
